Hill climbing isn't just an exercise term; it is a practical method for improving AI agent performance. In this clip from the GitHub Podcast, the team breaks down how hill climbing transitioned from model training into agent harness optimization. By using targeted evals to continuously benchmark and steer responses, developers can systematically refine agent accuracy over time.
